# PremLabs — Prem Sarojanand

> Prem Sarojanand is a senior software engineer and technical lead based in Ahmedabad, India, with 13+ years of experience in Java, Node.js, Python, PHP and C#. He builds backend systems, full-stack applications, DevOps pipelines and LLM-powered products, and is available for remote roles and freelance work. Contact: psarojanand@gmail.com

## Profile and projects
- [Portfolio and project catalog](https://premlabs.github.io/): skills by language (Java, Node.js, Python) and selected work, including an AI-powered CRM, a POS platform used in 36+ stores, a microservices redesign that cut API response times by 65%, and Jenkins/Docker CI/CD.
- [Juno Health case study](https://premlabs.github.io/projects/juno-health/): AI preventive healthcare platform (Node.js backend, Flutter app, doctor web app, OpenAI and Claude APIs with outputs validated against patient profiles). 1,000+ downloads, 3 B2B clients.
